name: beagle

white_mesh.traits: rounded skull, long soft drooping ears, medium muzzle length, deep chest, torso length, leg lengths, paw placement and upright tail
white_mesh.tail: the tail held upright with a gentle curve

subject: subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the dog shown in the reference images, an adult tricolor Beagle: a short, dense, smooth and glossy coat; a black saddle over the back and upper flanks; rich tan on the head, ears, shoulders and thighs; white on the muzzle blaze, chest, belly, legs, paws and most of the tail; long soft drooping ears; a tapering tail held out behind. No collar.
color_boundary: boundaries between the black, tan and white patches

muzzle: short, dense, smooth white fur on the muzzle and a white blaze up the forehead, a finely textured black nose, whiskers
cheek: short, sleek tan fur on the cheek that turns white toward the lips, a natural dark brown eye with soft eyelids, whiskers
ear: the outer side of the {side} ear
a long, soft, drooping ear covered in very short, velvety tan fur, with a smooth rounded lower edge
chest: short, dense, smooth white fur on the chest and throat, lying flat and pointing downward
front_paw: short, smooth, dense white fur on the lower leg; a compact round paw with short fur between the toes, dark nails and dark toe pads touching the floor
front_paw2: the whole {side} front paw, seen from slightly above
short, smooth, dense white fur on the lower leg; a compact round paw with short fur between the toes and dark nails, the whole paw standing on the floor
front_leg: the outer side of the {side} front leg
short, sleek white fur lying flat along the leg, turning tan at the top of the shoulder
flank: a short, dense, glossy coat lying flat backward along the body: a black saddle on the upper flank, tan below and behind it, white toward the belly
thigh: short, dense, smooth fur on the thigh, tan on the outside and white on the back and inner side of the leg, lying flat downward
hind_paw: short, smooth white fur on the hock and lower hind leg; a compact round paw with short fur between the toes and dark nails
hind_paw2: the whole {side} hind paw, seen from slightly above
short, smooth white fur on the hock and lower hind leg; a compact round paw with short fur between the toes and dark nails, the whole paw standing on the floor
tail: a tapering tail with short, dense fur, white for most of its length with some black and tan near the base, slightly brushier underneath
back: a short, dense, glossy black saddle coat lying smoothly backward along the spine
